rules: A source_id not listed in this registry is denied for every usage (local index, redistribution, training, retrieval).
A listed source whose status is not APPROVED or RETRIEVAL_ONLY is denied for retrieval and denied for indexing.
approved_for_local_index requires status APPROVED; RETRIEVAL_ONLY sources may be queried live but never written into rag/corpus/ or rag/index/.
REVIEW_REQUIRED sources are denied until a human-reviewed license verification is recorded in LICENSE_MANIFEST.md and the status is changed.
Changing a status or any approved_for_* flag requires a registry_version bump and a note in the change_log.
Never fabricate license or attribution metadata; if a fact is unknown, the source stays REVIEW_REQUIRED.

field_semantics.approved_for_local_index: Mango usage policy: chunks of this source may be written into rag/corpus/ and rag/index/.
field_semantics.approved_for_redistribution: Mango usage policy: corpus derived from this source may be redistributed outside Mango. Deny unless the license clearly permits it without further obligations Mango cannot meet.
field_semantics.approved_for_training: Mango usage policy: text of this source may be used for SFT/pretraining. License permission is necessary but not sufficient; a separate attribution pipeline must exist first.

sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (article text; some legacy content under earlier CC BY-SA versions)
sources.redistribution_policy: Attribution required; share-alike: derived corpora must carry CC BY-SA and credit contributors. Mango policy: no external redistribution of the derived corpus.
sources.attribution_requirements: Per chunk: article title, canonical URL, revision id, retrieved_at date, 'Text from Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0'.
sources.retrieval_method: MediaWiki API action=query prop=extracts (explaintext, exsectionformat=wiki); curated seed pages per configs/rag.yaml only; never the full dump
sources.notes: Primary T5 Tier-1 corpus. Retrieval material only; T5 policy forbids dumping Wikipedia into SFT weights (approved_for_training=false at Mango policy level even though the license would permit attribution-based training use).

sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (textbook content; verify per book — media may differ)
sources.redistribution_policy: Attribution required; share-alike not required for CC BY 4.0. Believed redistributable with attribution, pending per-book verification.
sources.attribution_requirements: Book title, authors, OpenStax, CC BY 4.0, section, URL.
sources.retrieval_method: to be defined (web/PDF extraction adapter) — connector not implemented in T5
sources.notes: T5.2 Tier-1 candidate. Do not ingest until a per-book license verification (including media assets) is recorded in LICENSE_MANIFEST.md.

sources.source_name: NASA public data (web text, fact sheets, images metadata)
sources.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work; NASA media guidelines apply; some content may carry third-party restrictions)
sources.redistribution_policy: Generally redistributable with attribution request (Suggested attribution: NASA/<source>). Verify per-dataset.
sources.retrieval_method: to be defined (connector adapter; T5 architectures for expansion, does not ingest)
sources.notes: Tier-2 authoritative connector slot. APPROVED as a usage category; no ingestion occurs in T5 (connector not implemented).

sources.source_name: NOAA public data (weather/climate/ocean text and datasets)
sources.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work; per-dataset caveats possible)
sources.retrieval_method: to be defined (connector adapter; not implemented in T5)
sources.notes: Tier-2 authoritative connector slot; not ingested in T5.

sources.license: Abstracts: publisher copyright retained; NLM permits retrieval for personal/research use but restricts bulk redistribution
sources.redistribution_policy: Bulk redistribution restricted by NLM policy. Retrieval on demand acceptable; local durable indexing not approved.
sources.attribution_requirements: Journal, authors, PMID, DOI, publisher copyright notice.
sources.retrieval_method: E-utilities efetch/esearch (respect rate limits); connector not implemented in T5
sources.notes: Tier-2. REVIEW_REQUIRED because redistribution terms need explicit human review before any durable indexing.

sources.license: PER-ARTICLE: mixture of CC BY, CC BY-NC, CC0 and publisher licenses; must be resolved per PMCID
sources.redistribution_policy: Only individually license-cleared articles may be indexed or redistributed; blanket indexing not permitted.
sources.attribution_requirements: Authors, journal, PMCID, DOI, the article's own license statement.
sources.retrieval_method: PMC OAI-PMH / eutils; per-article license gate before indexing; connector not implemented in T5
sources.notes: Tier-2. Requires a per-article license-resolution step that does not exist yet.

sources.license: Metadata: CC0 (arXiv metadata policy). Full text: arXiv non-exclusive license or author-selected Creative Commons / other license, varying per paper.
sources.redistribution_policy: Metadata/abstracts retrievable per arXiv API terms; bulk full-text redistribution requires per-paper license audit. Preprint status must be preserved (not peer-reviewed).
sources.attribution_requirements: Title, authors, arXiv ID + version, date, subject category, license if exposed, URL.
sources.retrieval_method: arXiv Atom API (export.arxiv.org); per-paper records with provenance; connector not implemented in T5
sources.notes: Research papers are Tier-2 and treated differently from encyclopedic knowledge: live retrieval/lookup permitted, durable local indexing requires per-paper license audit (future milestone). peer_review_status must be recorded as 'preprint' unless genuinely known.

sources.license: Proprietary; subscription content. No redistribution, no bulk retrieval, no local indexing.
sources.notes: Explicit BLOCKED example of deny-by-default for proprietary publisher content.

change_log.change: Initial T5 registry: 1 APPROVED (wikipedia_en, primary corpus), 3 Tier-2 connectors pre-approved but not ingested (nasa_public, noaa_public), 1 RETRIEVAL_ONLY (arxiv), 3 REVIEW_REQUIRED (openstax, ncbi_pubmed_abstracts, pmc_open_access), 1 BLOCKED (sciencedirect).
